# Derick dos Santos

> Growth marketer and co-founder of OASIS Creative Co. Builds and runs acquisition systems for creators, small businesses and startups: Meta and Google Ads, landing pages, tracking and lifecycle automation. Remote from Brazil, working US business hours. Contract, freelance or part-time.

## Services
- Growth system: paid acquisition, landing page, tracking and lifecycle follow-up as one measurable journey. https://md-mkt.github.io/services.html#growth-system
- Paid ads and social: Meta and Google campaigns plus content, judged by bookings and sales. https://md-mkt.github.io/services.html#paid-social
- Video and automation: VSL and short-form editing, email sequences and follow-up flows. https://md-mkt.github.io/services.html#video-automation
Pricing depends on scope. Contact by WhatsApp or email: mdmarketingaus@gmail.com
